create_BaseReader_instance: create a BaseReader instance with objtype 0 for body only pose estimation data loading
register_tensor_data: register a data dictionary with joint keypoints and camera calibration tensors into the BaseReader
get_batched_data: get batched TensorFlow tensors including cropped images, 2D scoremaps, and PAF fields from the reader
project_3D_to_2D: project 3D joint keypoints to 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsics and distortion coefficients
create_gaussian_heatmap: create a 2D Gaussian heatmap scoremap from keypoint coordinates for pose estimation training targets
